description:
You are a QA engineer at a fintech company. The FinancialCalc library was recently shipped with zero automated tests. The CI/CD pipeline has been updated to require 80% code coverage before any PR can merge, but with no tests at all, the build fails the coverage gate every time.

Your task is to write a comprehensive xUnit test suite for the FinancialCalc library in the FinancialCalc.Tests project. The library contains three calculation classes:

1. LoanCalculator: Computes monthly payment and total interest for a fixed-rate installment loan. Takes principal, annual interest rate (decimal), and term in months.

2. CompoundInterestEngine: Computes the future value of an investment with periodic compounding. Takes principal, annual rate, compounding frequency per year, and years.

3. CurrencyConverter: Converts between currencies using a rate table. Supports multi-hop conversion (e.g., USD→EUR→GBP when no direct USD→GBP rate exists).

Write tests that cover:
- Happy path calculations with known expected values
- Edge cases (zero interest rate, single payment term, etc.)
- Exception/error cases (negative principal, invalid currency codes, etc.)
- At least 3 test methods per calculator class (9 total minimum)

The solution is already open in Visual Studio 2022. The test project already has the xUnit and Coverlet packages installed. Windows user: Docker, password: GymAnything123!
